part.text:
Fixed. The `NoIntervalsIterator.docID()` in `lucene/queries/src/java/org/apache/lucene/queries/intervals/IntervalBuilder.java:309` now returns `-1` when unpositioned (tracking position state through `nextDoc`/`advance`), per the `DocIdSetIterator` contract, instead of always returning `NO_MORE_DOCS`.

All 108 tests in `:lucene:queries` pass, including `TestIntervalBuilder` and `TestIntervalQuery`.
